record.question: Which of the following is not correct with respect to payment of arrears of bills?
options: Arrears of pay and fixed allowances of leave salary shall be drawn along with the ordinary monthly bill of the next month
It must be ensured that no part of the amount claimed had been drawn previously
A note of arrear bill may be made in the office copy or pay bill register
Subject to conditions, arrears of bills can be presented at any time and may include as many items as are necessary
